title: stevenia dahurica
intro: Stevenia dahurica, commonly known as Dahurian angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, primarily due to its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Stevenia dahurica include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its role in treating respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
